abstractEnglish: For every fixed ε > 0, we give a deterministic polynomial-time $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$-approximation for finite rational metric k-median with specified candidate facilities, opening at most k facilities. Under $`P\ne NP`$, the infimum approximation factor in this model is therefore $`1+2/e`$.
